approved_findings.evidence: W16 defines REVIEWER_COMMAND, REVIEWER_SESSION_ID, REVIEWER_CAPSULE_ID, REVIEWER_MODE, and REVIEWER_APPROVED_AT plus exact propagation. W14 invokes setup-benchmark.sh with its four arguments, fixed identity values, exact archive paths, and matching IDs. W15 alone owns exact session/capsule/mode/freshness binding. Goal 03 §7.1 and the W10 inventory row both declare W08,W09,W14,W16 dependencies.
